akatsuki-no-yona.summary: Princess Yona has lived a protected life in the castle of the kingdom of Kouka, protected by her gentle father, King Il, and her stern bodyguard Hak. She has loved her cousin Su-won since they were children and hopes to marry him. Around her sixteenth birthday, a coup inside the palace shatters her life and forces her to flee with Hak. Hunted and with nowhere safe to go, Yona learns of an old legend about four dragon warriors who served the kingdom's founder, and she sets out to find them, learning to fight and survive along the way. Studio Pierrot adapted Mizuho Kusanagi's shojo manga into 24 episodes from 2014 to 2015. Contains some violence.

kaoru-hana-wa-rin-to-saku.summary: Chidori High is a public school known for its delinquents, and right next door stands Kikyo Private Academy, an elite girls' school whose students look down on their rough neighbours. Rintaro Tsumugi, a tall Chidori student with an intimidating face, helps out at his family's bakery. One day a small, cheerful customer named Kaoruko Waguri praises his kindness instead of fearing him, and he later learns that she goes to Kikyo. Despite the hostility between their schools, the two slowly become friends, as do their classmates. CloverWorks adapted Saka Mikami's manga into 13 episodes in 2025, directed by Miyuki Kuroki. It is a sweet, slow-building romance.

tengoku-daimakyou.summary: Years after a disaster left Japan in ruins, Kiruko, a tough young woman who works as a bodyguard, is hired to escort Maru, a teenage boy searching for a place called Heaven. Maru has a special ability that lets him kill the monsters, known as man-eaters, that now roam the broken cities. As they travel together, the series also follows a second story: a group of gifted children raised inside a sealed, well-kept facility surrounded by high walls, where they have never seen the outside world. How the two stories connect is one of the show's mysteries. Production I.G adapted Masakazu Ishiguro's manga into 13 episodes in 2023, directed by Hirotaka Mori. Contains violence and sexual content.

3-gatsu-no-lion.summary: Rei Kiriyama turned professional at shogi while still in middle school, and at seventeen he lives alone in an apartment in Tokyo. Shogi is his job, but he plays with little joy, and he has cut himself off from almost everyone, including his complicated foster family. Then he meets the Kawamoto sisters, Akari, Hinata and little Momo, who live across the river and start feeding him and welcoming him into their home. Through their warmth, his rivals and his matches, Rei slowly starts to reconnect with people. Shaft adapted Chica Umino's manga into 22 episodes from 2016 to 2017, directed by Akiyuki Shinbo, followed by a second season. It is a thoughtful drama about loneliness and recovery.

lycoris-recoil.summary: Tokyo looks like one of the safest cities in the world, but its peace is kept by Direct Attack, a secret agency that stops crimes before they happen using Lycoris, orphaned teenage girls trained as agents. After disobeying orders during a mission, the serious, efficient Takina Inoue is sent away to LycoReco, a small café that serves as a branch of the agency. There she is paired with Chisato Nishikigi, a cheerful, carefree Lycoris famous for her skill who refuses to kill. Between serving sweets, the café takes on all kinds of jobs, from shopping to bodyguard work. A-1 Pictures produced this 13-episode original series in 2022, directed by Shingo Adachi. Contains gun violence.

vanitas-no-carte.summary: In a steampunk version of 19th-century Paris, vampires live hidden among humans. Noé Archiviste, a young vampire, is travelling to the city by airship when he meets Vanitas, a flamboyant human doctor who claims he can cure vampires. A curse known as malnomen is turning some vampires into violent creatures, and Vanitas treats it with the Book of Vanitas, a grimoire linked to a legendary vampire of the Blue Moon. Noé, who has his own reasons for seeking the book, decides to stay by Vanitas's side as the two investigate cases. Bones adapted Jun Mochizuki's manga in two parts of 12 episodes each, running from July 2021 to April 2022, directed by Tomoyuki Itamura.

given.summary: Ritsuka Uenoyama is a high school guitarist who has grown bored of music, even though he plays in a band with two older friends, the bassist Haruki and the drummer Akihiko. One day he finds a quiet classmate, Mafuyu Sato, holding a guitar with broken strings and reluctantly fixes it. Mafuyu begins following him around, asking to be taught. When Uenoyama finally hears him sing, his voice stirs something in him, and Mafuyu is brought into the band, though he is carrying a painful past. Lerche adapted Natsuki Kizu's boys' love manga into 11 episodes in 2019, directed by Hikaru Yamaguchi, followed by a film in 2020. It is a gentle romance about music and grief.

tokidoki-bosotto-russiago-de-dereru-tona.summary: Alisa Mikhailovna Kujou, known as Alya, is a half-Russian student at Seirei Private Academy whose grades, beauty and cool manner have made her famous across the school. She sits next to Masachika Kuze, a smart but lazy boy who stays up late playing games and often naps in class. Alya scolds him constantly, then mutters affectionate remarks to herself in Russian, sure that he cannot understand. What she does not know is that Masachika understands Russian perfectly, and he has to pretend not to while her comments leave him flustered. Doga Kobo adapted the light novels by SunSunSun, illustrated by Momoco, into 12 episodes in 2024. A romantic comedy with some fan service.

yamada-kun-to-lv999-no-koi-wo-suru.summary: College student Akane Kinoshita only started playing the online game Forest of Savior because her boyfriend did, and now he has dumped her for a girl he met through it. Angry and heartbroken, she keeps playing anyway and goes to one of the game's offline fan events, where she runs into Akito Yamada, a strikingly handsome high schooler with almost no expression who is a top-level player in her own guild. Yamada is blunt, game-obsessed and seems uninterested in people, but Akane gradually grows closer to him and the rest of the guild, both online and off. Madhouse adapted Mashiro's web manga into 13 episodes in 2023. It is a low-key romantic comedy.

nana.summary: Two twenty-year-old women, both named Nana, meet by chance on a train to Tokyo. Nana Komatsu is cheerful, romantic and dependent on others, heading to the city to be near her boyfriend. Nana Osaki is a cool, guarded punk singer who wants to make it big with her band, Black Stones. Later, they happen to view the same flat, number 707, and decide to share it. As they build very different lives in Tokyo, a close friendship grows between them, tested by work, music, love and ambition, and Osaki gives Komatsu the nickname Hachi. Madhouse adapted Ai Yazawa's manga into 47 episodes from 2006 to 2007, directed by Morio Asaka. A grown-up drama with sexual content.

shimoneta-to-iu-gainen-ga-sonzai-shinai-.summary: In a future Japan where strict morality laws have banned obscene words and images, every citizen wears a device that listens for anything indecent. Tanukichi Okuma, whose father was arrested as an infamous dirty-joke activist, enrolls at an elite school famous for its purity, hoping to get close to the student council president, Anna Nishikinomiya. Instead, he is dragged into SOX, an underground group led by Ayame Kajo, the vice-president, who secretly operates as the masked terrorist Blue Snow, spreading lewd jokes and drawings around the country. J.C.Staff adapted Hirotaka Akagi's light novels into 12 episodes in 2015, directed by Yohei Suzuki. It is a comedy built on crude sexual humour and fan service.

flcl.summary: Naota Nandaba is a twelve-year-old who acts older than he is and insists that nothing amazing ever happens in his small town of Mabase. That changes when Haruko Haruhara, a wild, hyperactive young woman on a Vespa scooter, runs him over and then hits him on the head with her bass guitar. Soon afterwards, strange things begin to emerge from the bump on his head, including giant robots, and Haruko moves into his family's home as a housekeeper. Chaos follows. Gainax and Production I.G made the six-episode OVA from 2000 to 2001, directed by Kazuya Tsurumaki and written by Yoji Enokido, with a soundtrack built around songs by the band The Pillows. Several sequels followed from 2018.

isekai-maou-to-shoukan-shoujo-no-dorei-m.summary: Takuma Sakamoto is a reclusive gamer who is so good at the online game Cross Reverie that he is known as its Demon Lord, playing a character named Diablo. One day he is summoned into a fantasy world just like the game, in Diablo's body, by two girls: Shera, an elf, and Rem, a pantherian. Each girl means to make him her servant with an enslavement spell, but his magic ring bounces the spell back, leaving both girls bound to him instead. Too shy to speak as himself, Takuma acts out his overbearing in-game persona instead. Ajia-do adapted Yukiya Murasaki's light novels into 12 episodes in 2018; a second season followed in 2021. Contains heavy fan service.

sekai-saikou-no-ansatsusha-isekai-kizoku.summary: The finest assassin on Earth has lived only as a tool of the organisation that raised him, and that organisation finally gets rid of him. A goddess then offers him a second life in a world of swords and magic, on one condition: he must kill that world's Hero, who is fated to destroy it. His new life begins as Lugh Tuatha Dé, heir to a noble family whose secret trade is assassination. Combining his past-life knowledge with magic, Lugh trains from childhood, this time determined to live as a human being, alongside companions such as Dia and Tarte. SILVER LINK. and Studio Palette adapted Rui Tsukiyo's light novels into 12 episodes in 2021. Contains violence and fan service.

welcome-to-the-n-h-k.summary: Tatsuhiro Sato is twenty-two, a college dropout who has barely left his apartment in years. Living off money from his parents, he convinces himself that his isolation is the work of a vast conspiracy run by a secret group he calls the N.H.K. Then a quiet young woman named Misaki Nakahara turns up and announces that she can cure him, offering a contract for nightly counselling sessions in the park. Around the same time, Sato discovers that his loud neighbour is Kaoru Yamazaki, an old junior from high school, and the two decide to make a dating-sim game together. Gonzo adapted Tatsuhiko Takimoto's novel into 24 episodes in 2006, directed by Yusuke Yamamoto. It deals with depression, addiction and suicide.

grave-of-the-fireflies.summary: In the summer of 1945, during the last months of the Second World War, an American firebombing raid destroys much of Kobe. Teenage Seita and his little sister Setsuko lose their home and are left to fend for themselves. They go to stay with a distant aunt, but as food grows scarce and tensions rise, Seita decides they should live on their own in an abandoned shelter by a pond, where Setsuko delights in the fireflies at night. Isao Takahata wrote and directed the film for Studio Ghibli, adapting Akiyuki Nosaka's semi-autobiographical short story, and it was released in Japan on 16 April 1988. It is a sombre war drama that depicts hunger and loss.

suzume-no-tojimari.summary: Suzume Iwato is a seventeen-year-old who lives with her aunt Tamaki in a quiet town in Kyushu. On her way to school she passes Souta Munakata, a young stranger asking the way to some ruins, and follows him to a ruined resort, where she finds a lone door standing in the open. Opening it sets off a chain of events: Souta is a Closer, whose job is to shut such doors before a giant worm-like force can escape and cause earthquakes. When a strange talking cat turns Souta into a child's three-legged chair, Suzume sets off across Japan to help him. Written and directed by Makoto Shinkai at CoMix Wave Films, the film opened in Japan on 11 November 2022.

kiznaiver.summary: Sugomori City looks like an ordinary Japanese town, but it was built for an experiment. Katsuhira Agata is a high schooler who barely feels pain and shows almost no emotion. Shortly before summer break, a mysterious, expressionless girl named Noriko Sonozaki tells him and a handful of classmates who have little in common that they have been chosen as Kiznaivers. Linked through the Kizna System, they now feel each other's injuries and pain, in a project said to aim at world peace. Forced to spend the summer together, the group has to learn to understand one another. Trigger produced the 12-episode original series in 2016, written by Mari Okada and directed by Hiroshi Kobayashi.

roku-de-nashi-majutsu-koushi-to-kinki-ky.summary: Sistine Fibel is a proud, hard-working student at the Alzano Imperial Magic Academy, where she and her gentle best friend Rumia Tingel are training to become mages. When their favourite teacher suddenly retires, his replacement is Glenn Radars, a lazy, rude and apparently useless instructor who arrives late, writes 'self-study' on the board and goes to sleep. Furious, Sistine demands a duel with him. But when danger reaches the academy, Glenn turns out to know far more about magic, and about fighting, than he lets on. LIDENFILMS adapted Taro Hitsuji's light novels into 12 episodes in 2017, directed by Hiraku Kaneko. It is a school fantasy with action and fan service.

kono-yuusha-ga-ore-tueee-kuse-ni-shincho.summary: Ristarte, an inexperienced goddess, is given the job of saving Gaeabrande, a world rated S-class in difficulty and overrun by a Demon Lord's forces. She picks Seiya Ryuuguuin as her hero because his stats far exceed those of anyone else. The trouble is that Seiya is absurdly cautious. He refuses to leave the summoning room until he has trained to the maximum, buys three sets of everything, and destroys even the weakest monsters many times over to be sure they are gone, all while treating Ristarte with deadpan contempt. White Fox adapted Light Tuchihi's light novels into 12 episodes in 2019, directed by Masayuki Sakoi. It is a fantasy comedy that parodies isekai stories.

hataraku-saibou-tv.summary: Inside a human body, trillions of cells work every day to keep their world alive, each pictured as a person with a job. AE3803 is a rookie red blood cell who has a terrible sense of direction and keeps getting lost while delivering oxygen through the body's maze of vessels. Along her routes she keeps running into U-1146, a white blood cell who fights off bacteria and viruses with brutal efficiency. Each episode deals with a different threat, such as a scrape, pollen allergy or a cold, and explains what the cells actually do. David Production adapted Akane Shimizu's manga into 13 episodes in 2018, directed by Kenichi Suzuki; a second season aired in 2021.

the-melancholy-of-haruhi-suzumiya.summary: Kyon is an ordinary, sarcastic high school student who long ago stopped believing in aliens, time travellers and espers. On the first day of class, the girl sitting behind him, Haruhi Suzumiya, announces that ordinary humans bore her and she is only interested in exactly those kinds of people. Restless and energetic, Haruhi drags Kyon into forming a new school club, the SOS Brigade, and recruits Yuki Nagato, a silent girl who is always reading, the timid Mikuru Asahina and the polite transfer student Itsuki Koizumi. Kyoto Animation adapted Nagaru Tanigawa's light novels into 14 episodes in 2006, directed by Tatsuya Ishihara, originally broadcast out of chronological order. New episodes were added in 2009.

91-days.summary: During Prohibition in the United States, the town of Lawless is run by mafia families who profit from bootleg liquor. Seven years ago, a boy named Angelo Lagusa watched his family get murdered, and he has been in hiding ever since. When an anonymous letter points him toward the killers, members of the Vanetti family, he returns to Lawless under the name Avilio Bruno. To get close to his targets, he befriends Nero Vanetti, the don's son, starting with a scheme to help the family brew its own alcohol, and begins working his way into their world. Shuka produced this 12-episode original series in 2016, directed by Hiro Kaburagi. Contains graphic violence.

gate-jieitai-kanochi-nite-kaku-tatakaeri.summary: A mysterious gate suddenly opens in the Ginza district of Tokyo, and an army of soldiers in Roman-style armour, along with dragons and other monsters, pours out and attacks the crowds. Japan's Self-Defense Forces drive them back with modern weapons, then cross through the gate to set up a base in the other world and open contact with the empire that sent the invaders. Among the officers sent across is Yoji Itami, a laid-back otaku who knows fantasy stories well, and his reconnaissance team soon meets an elf, a young mage and a priestess of a death god. A-1 Pictures adapted Takumi Yanai's novels in two 12-episode halves from 2015 to 2016, directed by Takahiko Kyogoku. Contains war violence.

trinity-seven.summary: Arata Kasuga lives an ordinary life in a small town alongside Hijiri, his cousin and oldest friend, until a phenomenon called the Black Sun wipes out the town and takes Hijiri with it. All she leaves him is a grimoire. To get her back, Arata decides to become a mage himself and joins the Royal Biblia Academy, a hidden school for magic users. There he meets the Trinity Seven, seven powerful female mages, each studying a different branch of magic, and begins training with them, often in compromising situations. Seven Arcs Pictures adapted the manga by Kenji Saito and Akinari Nao into 12 episodes in 2014, followed by films in 2017 and 2019. A harem comedy with heavy fan service.

koutetsujou-no-kabaneri.summary: On the island nation of Hinomoto, the dead have risen as Kabane, ferocious creatures whose hearts are shielded by iron, and survivors shelter inside fortified stations linked by armoured steam trains. Ikoma, a young steamsmith at Aragane Station, has been secretly building a weapon he believes can pierce a Kabane's heart. When an infected train crashes into the station and the creatures pour in, he finally tests it, but is bitten and fights off the infection to become a Kabaneri, part human and part Kabane. With a mysterious girl called Mumei and other survivors, he flees aboard the train Kotetsujo. Wit Studio produced this 12-episode original series in 2016, directed by Tetsuro Araki. Contains graphic violence.

black-bullet.summary: A parasitic virus called Gastrea has turned living things into monsters, and what remains of humanity survives inside zones ringed by giant Monoliths built from Varanium, a metal the creatures cannot stand. Some girls born carrying the virus, known as the Cursed Children, have superhuman abilities, and they fight Gastrea as Initiators, each paired with a human partner called a Promoter. Rentaro Satomi, a poor high school student, works as a Promoter for a small civil security agency in the Tokyo Area, partnered with Enju Aihara, a ten-year-old Initiator who insists she is his wife. Kinema Citrus and Orange adapted Shiden Kanzaki's light novels into 13 episodes in 2014, directed by Masayuki Kojima. Contains violence.

mushishi.summary: Mushi are primitive, near-invisible beings that most people cannot see but that can affect humans and nature in strange ways, from causing illness to bending sound and light. Ginko, a quiet, white-haired wanderer with one green eye, is a mushishi, an expert who travels through the countryside of an old Japan studying mushi and helping people troubled by them. Each episode is a mostly self-contained story set in a different village, where Ginko listens, investigates and tries to find a solution that harms neither people nor mushi. Artland adapted Yuki Urushibara's manga into 26 episodes from 2005 to 2006, directed by Hiroshi Nagahama. It is a calm, atmospheric anthology series.

hotarubi-no-mori-e.summary: When she is six, Hotaru wanders into the woods on a mountain by her grandfather's home one summer and gets lost. A boy in a mask, who calls himself Gin, helps her find the way home. He is not human: he lives in the forest among spirits, and if a human touches him, he will disappear forever. Hotaru keeps coming back each summer to spend time with him, careful never to make contact, and as she grows up, their friendship deepens despite the rule that keeps them apart. Brain's Base adapted Yuki Midorikawa's one-shot manga into a 44-minute film, directed by Takahiro Omori and released in September 2011. Midorikawa is also the creator of Natsume's Book of Friends.

shangri-la-frontier.summary: Rakuro Hizutome is a high schooler who loves trash games, buggy, unbalanced titles that most players avoid, and has beaten countless of them. Looking for a change, he finally tries Shangri-La Frontier, a hugely popular full-dive virtual reality game with tens of millions of players. Logging in as Sunraku, a half-naked character wearing a bird mask, he finds that the reflexes and patience he built up on broken games give him a big advantage, and he soon stumbles onto rare quests and powerful monsters. C2C adapted Ryosuke Fuji's manga, based on the web novel by Katarina, into 25 episodes from 2023 to 2024; a second season aired from 2024 to 2025. It is a game fantasy with lots of combat.

wind-breaker.summary: Haruka Sakura has been treated as an outsider all his life for his split black-and-white hair, mismatched eyes and prickly attitude, and trusts only his fists. He enrolls at Furin High School, which has a reputation as a school of delinquents where strength matters more than grades, planning to fight his way to the top. Instead he finds that Furin's students, known around town as Bofurin, use their strength to protect the shopping district of Makochi and its residents, and the locals treat him with a kindness he cannot handle. CloverWorks adapted Satoru Nii's web manga into 13 episodes in 2024, and a second season aired in 2025. Contains street fighting.

danshi-koukousei-no-nichijou.summary: Tadakuni, Hidenori and Yoshitake are three friends at Sanada North, an all-boys high school, and nothing especially important ever happens to them. Hidenori, who wears glasses, comes up with ridiculous ideas, Yoshitake happily goes along with them, and Tadakuni plays the reluctant straight man. They pretend to be heroes on the riverbank, overthink brief encounters with girls, put on dramatic role-play over the smallest things and run into girls from a nearby school. Each episode is made up of short comedy sketches, some following other characters entirely. Sunrise adapted Yasunobu Yamauchi's web manga into 12 episodes in 2012, directed by Shinji Takamatsu. It is a deadpan slice-of-life comedy.

wolf-children.summary: Hana, a college student in Tokyo, falls for a quiet man and learns that he can turn into a wolf. They build a life together and have two children, Yuki, an energetic girl, and Ame, a shy boy, both of whom can change between human and wolf form. When Hana is left to raise them on her own, keeping their secret in a crowded city becomes impossible, so she moves to an old farmhouse in the countryside, where she learns to farm and win over her neighbours while the children grow up and choose who they want to be. Mamoru Hosoda directed and co-wrote the film at Studio Chizu, and it opened in Japan on 21 July 2012.

nakitai-watashi-wa-neko-wo-kaburu.summary: Miyo Sasaki is a lively, odd fourteen-year-old in the pottery town of Tokoname who has an open crush on classmate Kento Hinode, who mostly finds her embarrassing. Her classmates call her Muge. Struggling with a difficult home life, Miyo has found a secret way to escape: a mysterious mask seller has given her a mask that turns her into a cat. As the cat, whom Hinode calls Taro, she can visit him and hear the worries he tells nobody else. But the line between girl and cat starts to blur. Studio Colorido made the film, with Junichi Sato and Tomotaka Shibayama directing; it was released on Netflix on 18 June 2020.

dorohedoro.summary: The Hole is a filthy, rundown city where sorcerers come through doorways from their own world to practise magic on the people who live there, often with horrible results. Caiman is a victim of this, a man whose head was turned into a lizard's and who cannot remember his past. With his friend Nikaido, a tough young woman who runs a gyoza restaurant, he hunts sorcerers, putting their heads in his mouth so that a mysterious man in his throat can tell them whether they are the one who cursed him. Meanwhile, the powerful sorcerer En sends his crew after Caiman. MAPPA adapted Q Hayashida's manga into 12 episodes in 2020, directed by Yuichiro Hayashi. Contains graphic gore.

toaru-majutsu-no-index.summary: Academy City is a walled city in Tokyo where most residents are students and science is used to develop psychic powers. Toma Kamijo is a high schooler there rated as having no power at all, yet his right hand, the Imagine Breaker, can cancel any supernatural ability it touches, and seems to cancel his luck too. One morning he finds a young girl in a white nun's habit hanging over his balcony railing. She is Index, a nun from a secret branch of the Church of England whose memory holds 103,000 forbidden books of magic, which makes her a target for sorcerers. J.C.Staff adapted Kazuma Kamachi's light novels into 24 episodes from 2008 to 2009, directed by Hiroshi Nishikiori.

sakamoto-desu-ga.summary: From the moment he arrives at high school, Sakamoto is the coolest person anyone has ever seen. He is tall, calm, polite and stylish, the girls adore him, and he handles every situation with effortless grace, however strange. Jealous classmates set up pranks to embarrass him, and bullies try to push him around, but he always turns things around with an elegant, often absurd solution, and sometimes ends up helping the very people who targeted him. Each episode builds on increasingly ridiculous scenarios played completely straight. Studio Deen adapted Nami Sano's manga into 12 episodes in 2016, written and directed by Shinji Takamatsu. It is a deadpan school comedy.

kokoro-connect.summary: Iori Nagase, Taichi Yaegashi, Himeko Inaba, Yui Kiriyama and Yoshifumi Aoki are the only members of their high school's Student Cultural Society, a club they started because none of the existing ones suited them. One day they suddenly begin switching bodies at random, without warning. Behind it is a strange being calling itself Heartseed, who seems to be using them for an experiment. As the body swaps and other strange phenomena continue, the five are forced to see each other's lives from the inside, and secrets and insecurities they had kept hidden start to come out. SILVER LINK. adapted Sadanatsu Anda's light novels into 13 TV episodes in 2012, directed by Shinya Kawatsura, followed by four more episodes.

baccano.summary: Baccano! tells several stories set in Prohibition-era America that at first seem to have nothing to do with one another. In New York, rival mafia families feud while a scientist hunts for missing bottles of a liquid said to make people immortal. Meanwhile, a transcontinental express called the Flying Pussyfoot pulls out of Chicago with gangsters, oddballs and a pair of cheerful, clueless thieves, Isaac and Miria, on board, and the trip turns bloody. The episodes jump back and forth in time, leaving viewers to piece events together. Brain's Base adapted Ryohgo Narita's light novels into 13 episodes in 2007. Contains frequent graphic violence.

yamada-kun-to-7-nin-no-majo-tv.summary: Suzaku High student Ryu Yamada has poor grades, a short temper and a reputation for fights. One day he slips on the stairs and crashes into Urara Shiraishi, the school's top student, and when their lips meet the two swap bodies. Swapping back takes another kiss. Toranosuke Miyamura, a student council member, pulls them into the Supernatural Studies Club, and they learn of a school legend about seven witches, each a girl whose special power is triggered by a kiss. LIDENFILMS adapted Miki Yoshikawa's manga into 12 episodes in spring 2015. It is a light romantic comedy with mystery elements.

ponyo-on-a-cliff.summary: Five-year-old Sosuke lives in a house on a cliff above the sea with his mother Lisa, while his father Koichi is often away at sea on his ship. Playing on the shore, Sosuke rescues a little goldfish trapped in a jar and names her Ponyo. She is really a magical sea creature who has slipped away from her protective father Fujimoto, a former human who now lives under the waves as a sorcerer. Ponyo grows fond of Sosuke and decides she wants to be human, and her wish starts to stir up the ocean. Hayao Miyazaki wrote and directed this Studio Ghibli film, released in Japan in July 2008. It is suitable for all ages.

josee-to-tora-to-sakana-tachi.summary: Tsuneo Suzukawa is a university student who loves diving and marine biology, and he works several part-time jobs to save up for a chance to study overseas. One night an accident brings him face to face with Kumiko, a young woman who uses a wheelchair, rarely leaves home and insists on being called Josee. Her grandmother hires Tsuneo to look after her. Josee is prickly and demanding, and the job is not what he expected, but she also dreams of seeing the world beyond her house. Bones animated this film, with Kotaro Tamura directing, from a short story by Seiko Tanabe; it opened in Japan in December 2020.

hige-wo-soru-soshite-joshikousei-wo-hiro.summary: Yoshida is an office worker who has just been turned down by Airi Gotou, the boss he has had a crush on for years. Walking home drunk, he comes across Sayu Ogiwara, a high schooler sitting by the road. She has run away from her home in Hokkaido and asks to stay with him. Yoshida refuses anything improper but cannot bring himself to throw her out, so he lets her live in his small apartment in exchange for doing chores, and an odd shared life begins. Project No.9 adapted Shimesaba's light novels into 13 episodes, aired from April to June 2021. The story deals with the sexual exploitation of a minor.

berserk.summary: Guts is a young mercenary who lives for battle and swings a sword almost as large as he is. He drifts from one paying job to the next until he runs into a mercenary company called the Band of the Hawk. Its leader is Griffith, a charismatic, gifted swordsman with grand ambitions. After losing a duel to Griffith, Guts is made to join the band, where he finds comrades for the first time, including the fierce commander Casca. Most of the series covers these years of war in a dark, medieval-style world. OLM adapted Kentaro Miura's manga into 25 episodes from 1997 to 1998. Contains graphic violence and sexual violence.

kiki-s-delivery-service.summary: Kiki is a 13-year-old witch, and tradition says she must leave home for a year and settle in a new town to finish her training. Taking her broom and her talkative black cat Jiji, she flies off and lands in Koriko, a busy seaside city. Finding a place there is harder than she hoped, until a kind baker named Osono offers her a room. Kiki uses the one skill she has, flying, to start a delivery service, and has to learn to look after herself. Hayao Miyazaki wrote, produced and directed this 1989 Studio Ghibli film, adapted from Eiko Kadono's 1985 novel. It is suitable for all ages.

eromanga-sensei.summary: High schooler Masamune Izumi earns a living writing light novels while looking after his younger stepsister Sagiri, who has shut herself in her room for a year and will not come out. His books are illustrated by an artist known only as Eromanga-sensei, whom he has never met and who is notorious for drawing racy pictures. Through an embarrassing mix-up, Masamune finds out the illustrator is Sagiri. The two start working together openly while dealing with rival authors and the publishing world. A-1 Pictures adapted Tsukasa Fushimi's light novels into 12 episodes in spring 2017. Contains frequent fan service and sexual jokes, much of it involving teenage characters.

kenja-no-mago.summary: A young Japanese office worker dies and is reborn as a baby in a world of magic, keeping all his old memories. He is found and raised in the forest by Merlin Wolford, a retired national hero, who names him Shin and teaches him everything he knows. By fifteen, Shin's magic and fighting skills are astonishing, but he has almost no common sense and no idea how ordinary people live. To fix that, he heads to the capital of the kingdom of Earlshide and enrolls in its magic academy, where he quickly makes friends and draws attention. SILVER LINK. adapted Tsuyoshi Yoshioka's light novels into 12 episodes in 2019.

hai-to-gensou-no-grimgar.summary: A group of young people wake up in darkness and find themselves in Grimgar, a land of swords and magic. None of them remembers anything about their old lives except their own names. The only work on offer is joining the Reserve Army as volunteer soldiers, so those left over after the strongest team up form a party of their own: the timid thief Haruhiro, the calm priest Manato, the gentle warrior Moguzo, the obnoxious Ranta, and Yume and Shihoru. Even fighting a single goblin is a struggle. A-1 Pictures adapted Ao Jumonji's light novels into 12 episodes in early 2016, with a slow, quiet pace. Contains violence.

itai-no-wa-lya-nano-de-bougyoryoku-ni-ky.summary: Kaede Honjo has never played a video game, but her friend talks her into joining New World Online, a popular virtual reality MMO. Creating a character named Maple, Kaede decides she would simply rather not get hurt, so she puts every point she has into defence. That should make her slow and weak, yet her odd play style unlocks strange and powerful skills, and before long she is a feared, almost unbeatable player who is mostly just having fun. Her friend Risa soon joins as Sally. SILVER LINK. adapted Yuumikan's light novels into 12 episodes in early 2020, and a second season followed. It is a light, cheerful comedy.

free.summary: Haruka Nanase loves water so much that he will dive into anything wet, but he only swims freestyle and cares little for competing. As kids, he, Rin Matsuoka, Makoto Tachibana and Nagisa Hazuki won a relay together, then went separate ways. In high school, Rin returns from abroad, attending a rival school and determined to prove he is faster than Haruka. Makoto and Nagisa respond by starting a swim club at Iwatobi High, and they need a fourth member, so they recruit Rei Ryugazaki from the track team. Kyoto Animation and Animation Do produced the 12-episode first season in summer 2013; more seasons followed.

akagami-no-shirayuki-hime.summary: Shirayuki is a cheerful herbalist in the kingdom of Tanbarun, born with rare apple-red hair. That hair catches the eye of Tanbarun's spoiled prince, Raji, who orders her to become his concubine. Rather than give up her freedom, she cuts off her hair and flees across the border into the woods. There she meets Zen Wistalia, a younger prince of neighbouring Clarines, along with his two aides. Shirayuki decides to make her own way in Clarines and aims for a post as a court herbalist at the palace. Bones adapted Sorata Akiduki's manga; the 12-episode first season aired in summer 2015 and a second followed in 2016.

kuzu-no-honkai.summary: At school, Hanabi Yasuraoka and Mugi Awaya look like an ideal couple, but neither loves the other. Hanabi has adored Narumi Kanai, the older neighbour she grew up with, for years, and he is now her homeroom teacher. Mugi has been in love with Akane Minagawa, the young music teacher who tutored him in middle school. When Narumi and Akane start getting close, Hanabi and Mugi make a pact to use each other as stand-ins for the people they really want, physically included. Lerche adapted Mengo Yokoyari's manga into 12 episodes, aired from January to March 2017. It is a heavy romantic drama with frequent sexual content.

spice-and-wolf.summary: Kraft Lawrence is a travelling merchant who has spent years driving his cart from town to town, hoping to save enough to open his own shop. Passing through the farming village of Pasloe, he finds a girl with wolf ears and a tail sleeping in his cart. She is Holo, a centuries-old wolf deity who once watched over the village harvest but feels forgotten now that the farmers no longer need her. Proud and sharp-witted, she asks Lawrence to take her north to her homeland. The series is driven by trade, haggling and their banter. Imagin adapted Isuna Hasekura's light novels into 13 episodes in 2008. Contains some nudity.

vivy-fluorite-eye-s-song.summary: In a future where artificial intelligence is part of everyday life, every AI is built for a single purpose. Vivy, the first fully autonomous AI, was made to sing and make people happy, and she performs day after day at a theme park to small, distracted crowds. Then a strange AI calling itself Matsumoto appears, claiming to come from a hundred years ahead, where machines have turned on humanity. He needs Vivy's help to change history before that war can happen, and she is pulled into a mission spread across a century. Wit Studio produced this 13-episode original series, broadcast in spring 2021. Contains violence.

tsue-to-tsurugi-no-wistoria.summary: At Regarden Magic Academy, magic decides everything, and Will Serfort cannot cast a single spell. As children, he and his friend Elfaria promised to meet at the summit of the Wizard's Tower, where the five greatest mages keep watch over the world. Elfaria has already become one of them, while Will is mocked by teachers and classmates for having no magic at all. What he does have is a sword, an exceptionally strong body and the stubbornness to keep fighting, whether against monsters in the academy's dungeon or against mages who look down on him. Actas and Bandai Namco Pictures adapted the manga by Fujino Omori and Toshi Aoi into 12 episodes in 2024.

blend-s.summary: Maika Sakuranomiya is a sweet, cheerful high schooler who wants a part-time job to save up for studying abroad. Interviews keep going badly because, whenever she smiles, her face looks oddly threatening. Then she stumbles on Café Stile, a café where each waitress plays a character type for the customers. The owner, an Italian man named Dino who is instantly smitten with her, hires Maika to play the cold, sadistic waitress, a role that suits her accidental glare and her clumsiness. Her co-workers include Kaho, who plays a tsundere, and Mafuyu, who plays a little sister. A-1 Pictures adapted Miyuki Nakayama's four-panel manga into 12 episodes in late 2017.

tomo-chan-wa-onna-no-ko.summary: Tomo Aizawa is a tall, sporty girl who trains in karate and acts more like one of the guys than most guys do. Her best friend since childhood is Junichiro Kubota, and she has fallen for him. When she finally confesses at the start of high school, Jun treats her like a buddy, not a girl, and the message does not get through. With help, and sometimes sabotage, from her blunt friend Misuzu and the cheerful Carol, Tomo keeps trying to make Jun see her differently. Lay-duce adapted Fumita Yanagida's manga, which began as short online strips, into 13 episodes from January to March 2023. It is a romantic comedy.

saenai-heroine-no-sodate-kata.summary: Tomoya Aki is a devoted otaku who decides to make his own dating-sim visual novel to sell at a fan convention. His inspiration is a girl he met one spring day, Megumi Kato, though she turns out to be a classmate so unremarkable that almost nobody notices her. To build the game he needs talent, so he pressures two gifted, prickly girls into joining: his childhood friend Eriri Spencer Sawamura, an illustrator, and the older student Utaha Kasumigaoka, a published novelist. Both have complicated feelings about Tomoya. A-1 Pictures adapted Fumiaki Maruto's light novels in early 2015, and a second season followed. Contains fan service.

shinsekai-yori.summary: A thousand years from now, people with psychokinetic powers live in small, peaceful villages surrounded by protective barriers. In Kamisu 66, one such town, twelve-year-old Saki Watanabe finally awakens her power and joins Shun, Maria, Mamoru, Satoru and other children at an academy where children learn to control it. Life seems calm, but the adults keep secrets, classmates sometimes vanish without explanation, and on a summer trip the friends meet mole-like creatures that treat humans as gods. What they learn starts to unsettle everything they were taught. A-1 Pictures adapted Yusuke Kishi's novel into 25 episodes from 2012 to 2013. Contains violence and some sexual content.

shiguang-daili-ren.summary: Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang run a small photo studio in a modern Chinese city, but their real business is unusual. Using their powers, Cheng can jump into a photograph and spend twelve hours in the body of the person who took it, while Lu Guang guides him with what he knows about what happened next. Clients pay them to find lost things, ask questions they never got to ask, or understand something from the past. The rule is that they must not change history, and keeping to it gets harder as cases grow personal. Li Haoling wrote and directed this Chinese series, which Studio LAN animated; its 11 episodes streamed in 2021.

higurashi-no-naku-koro-ni.summary: In 1983, Keiichi Maebara moves from the city to Hinamizawa, a tiny village in the mountains. He quickly makes friends with a lively group of classmates, Rena, Mion, Satoko and Rika, and spends his days playing games with them. But as the village's yearly festival approaches, he hears about a string of deaths and disappearances tied to it and to the local god, Oyashiro, and his friends start acting strangely when he asks. The story is told in separate arcs that each replay events from a new angle. Studio Deen adapted 07th Expansion's visual novels, created by Ryukishi07, into 26 episodes in 2006. Contains graphic violence and horror.

ghost-in-the-shell.summary: In 2029, most people are connected to computer networks, and many have replaced their bodies with cybernetic parts. Major Motoko Kusanagi, whose own body is almost entirely artificial, leads a field team in Section 9, a government unit that deals with cybercrime and terrorism. Her team is pursuing a mysterious hacker known as the Puppet Master, who can break into people's minds and rewrite their memories. As the case unfolds, she begins to question what makes her human. Directed by Mamoru Oshii and animated by Production I.G, this 1995 film adapts Masamune Shirow's manga. It is a slow, philosophical thriller with bursts of violence and some nudity.

otonari-no-tenshisama-ni-itsunomanika-da.summary: Mahiru Shiina is so beautiful, polite and talented that her classmates call her an angel. Amane Fujimiya, a lazy student who lives alone, happens to be her next-door neighbour, though they have never spoken. One rainy day he sees her sitting alone on a swing in a park and gives her his umbrella. When he catches a cold as a result, she shows up to look after him, and then, appalled by his messy apartment and poor diet, keeps coming back to cook for him. A quiet friendship forms. Project No.9 adapted Saekisan's light novels into 12 episodes from January to March 2023. It is a gentle, slow-paced romance.

darker-than-black.summary: Ten years ago, two mysterious zones known as Heaven's Gate and Hell's Gate appeared, one in South America and one in Tokyo, and the real stars vanished from the sky. At the same time, people called Contractors emerged, gaining supernatural powers but losing much of their emotion, and each must perform an odd personal ritual after using them. In Tokyo, police section chief Misaki Kirihara keeps running into an agent codenamed Hei, a Contractor known as the Black Reaper who carries out covert missions for a secret organisation. Tensai Okamura created this original series and directed it for Bones; its 25 episodes aired in 2007. Contains violence.

great-teacher-onizuka.summary: Eikichi Onizuka is a 22-year-old former biker gang leader with no manners, no money and few prospects. He decides to become a teacher, partly for shallow reasons, and somehow lands a job at Holy Forest Academy, an elite private school in Tokyo. He is given the class nobody else wants, one whose students have driven several teachers out with cruel pranks. Onizuka responds with wild, unorthodox methods and a stubborn loyalty to his students and their problems. Studio Pierrot adapted Toru Fujisawa's manga into 43 episodes from 1999 to 2000. It is a comedy-drama with crude humour and deals with bullying, abuse and suicide.

tsuki-ga-michibiku-isekai-douchuu.summary: Makoto Misumi is just a regular high school student until he is summoned to another world because of a deal his parents made long ago. The goddess who rules it takes one look at him, calls him hideous and refuses to make him a hero. She throws him out to the edge of the world's wastelands, where he cannot even speak the language of the humans. However, Makoto turns out to be incredibly strong there, and he begins gathering powerful allies, starting with a dragon and a spider, among the creatures and demi-humans that humans reject. C2C adapted Kei Azumi's light novels into 12 episodes in summer 2021; a second season followed. It is a light fantasy comedy.

gamers.summary: Keita Amano is a quiet high schooler who loves video games and has no ambitions beyond playing them. One day Karen Tendo, the most admired girl at school, notices him in a game shop and invites him to join the school's game club. He turns her down, since the club takes gaming far more seriously than he does, but that choice sets off a chain of misunderstandings involving Karen, the gamer girl Chiaki Hoshinomori, his new friend Tasuku Uehara and Tasuku's girlfriend Aguri. Everyone ends up misreading everyone else's feelings. PINE JAM adapted Sekina Aoi's light novels into 12 episodes in summer 2017. It is a romantic comedy built on misunderstandings.

the-girl-who-leapt-through-time.summary: Makoto Konno is a high school girl in Tokyo who is not sure what she wants to do with her life and mostly spends afternoons playing catch with her friends Chiaki and Kosuke. After a strange incident at school, she finds she can leap backwards in time. At first she uses it for small things, like retaking tests, avoiding embarrassment or reliving good days, but she starts to see that her changes affect the people around her. Directed by Mamoru Hosoda and animated by Madhouse, this 2006 film is loosely based on Yasutaka Tsutsui's 1967 novel, taking the same premise but with a new story and characters. It is a coming-of-age drama.

inuyashiki.summary: Ichiro Inuyashiki is 58 but looks far older, and his wife and children barely hide their contempt for him. His only comfort is Hanako, a stray Shiba Inu he adopts. After a doctor tells him he has terminal cancer, he runs off to a park at night, where a blinding light hits him. He wakes up with his memories intact but with a machine body full of weapons and abilities. A teenager named Hiro Shishigami was caught in the same event and gained the same powers, and the two choose to use them very differently. MAPPA adapted Hiroya Oku's manga into 11 episodes in late 2017. Contains graphic violence.

darwins-game.summary: A classmate sends high schooler Kaname Sudo an invite to Darwin's Game, a mobile app he has never heard of. When he opens it, a green snake lunges out of the screen and bites him. Before long he discovers the game is played in the real world: players hunt one another for points, losers die, and each participant gains a unique supernatural ability called a Sigil. Kaname is thrown into fights for his life on his very first day, and soon crosses paths with Shuka, a feared top-ranked player. Nexus adapted the manga by FLIPFLOPs into 11 episodes in early 2020. Contains graphic violence and some fan service.

inuyasha.summary: On her fifteenth birthday, Kagome Higurashi is dragged by a monster into the old well at her family's Tokyo shrine and emerges in Japan's warring states period, a time full of demons. She learns she carries the Shikon Jewel, a sacred gem that every demon wants. To survive, she frees Inuyasha, a hot-tempered half-demon pinned to a tree by an arrow fifty years ago, who mistakes her for a priestess he hated. When the jewel is shattered and its shards scattered, the two must team up to find them. Sunrise adapted Rumiko Takahashi's manga into 167 episodes from 2000 to 2004; a final season followed. Contains action violence.

k-project.summary: In a modern Japan where seven Kings hold supernatural powers and lead clans of followers, a video appears online showing a member of the Red clan being murdered. The killer in the footage looks exactly like Yashiro Isana, a cheerful, easygoing student at a school on an island near the city. Soon the Red clan wants him dead, and so does Kuroh Yatogami, a serious swordsman calling himself the Black Dog. Yashiro insists he has no memory of the crime. Meanwhile the Blue clan works to keep order among the Kings. GoHands created the series with the writing group GoRA, directed by Shingo Suzuki; its 13 episodes aired in late 2012.

himouto-umaru-chan.summary: At school, Umaru Doma seems flawless: beautiful, smart, athletic and polite, admired by everyone. At home, the moment she pulls on her hamster-eared hoodie, she shrinks into a lazy, snack-hoarding gamer who demands cola, chips and anime while her long-suffering older brother Taihei, an office worker, cooks and cleans. Each episode follows her double life in short comic sketches, along with her friendships with classmates Nana and Kirie and her self-declared rival Sylphynford. Doga Kobo adapted Sankakuhead's manga into 12 episodes in summer 2015, and a second season followed. It is a light comedy about siblings and friendship.

kamisama-hajimemashita-kiss.summary: Nanami Momozono is left with nowhere to live after her father runs away to escape his debts. Sitting in a park, she rescues a strange man from a dog, and he thanks her by offering her his home. It turns out to be a run-down shrine, and the man, Mikage, was its land god; Nanami has now inherited the role. The shrine's familiar, a proud and bad-tempered fox spirit named Tomoe, wants nothing to do with a human god, but a contract sealed with a kiss binds him to serve her. TMS Entertainment adapted Julietta Suzuki's shojo manga into 13 episodes in late 2012, and a second season followed. It is a romantic comedy.

monster-musume-no-iru-nichijou.summary: In a version of Japan where mythical species have been revealed to exist, a government exchange programme places non-human visitors in human homes. Kimihito Kurusu, a student living alone, is accidentally assigned Miia, a lamia with a snake's lower body. Her coordinator, the lazy Ms. Smith, soon adds more guests, including a harpy, a centaur, a slime and a mermaid, and all of them become attached to him. The programme's rules forbid any violence between hosts and guests, so his days become a string of near disasters. Lerche adapted Okayado's manga into 12 episodes in summer 2015. Contains heavy fan service and frequent nudity.

trigun.summary: On Gunsmoke, a desert planet of scattered frontier towns, the gunman Vash the Stampede carries a reward of 60 billion double dollars for supposedly wiping out a city. Rumour calls him the Humanoid Typhoon, and trouble follows him everywhere. In person, though, Vash is a goofy, doughnut-loving pacifist who will go to great lengths to avoid killing anyone. Two insurance company agents, the serious Meryl Stryfe and the cheerful Milly Thompson, are assigned to follow him and limit the damage he causes. Madhouse adapted Yasuhiro Nightow's manga into 26 episodes in 1998, directed by Satoshi Nishimura. It mixes comedy and Western-style gunfights with violence.

mairimashita-iruma-kun.summary: Iruma Suzuki is a kind, unlucky 14-year-old whose selfish parents have made him work since childhood. Then they sell him to a demon. Fortunately, the demon, Sullivan, only wants a grandchild to spoil, so he takes Iruma to the Netherworld and enrolls him at Babyls, a school for demons, where Sullivan happens to be the chairman. Humans are rare there and may be eaten, so Iruma must hide what he is, but his inability to say no and his habit of attracting attention keep making that harder. He soon befriends the devoted Alice and the chaotic Clara. Bandai Namco Pictures adapted Osamu Nishi's manga into 23 episodes from 2019 to 2020; more seasons followed.

karakai-jouzu-no-takagi-san.summary: Nishikata is a middle school boy who sits next to Takagi, a classmate who loves to tease him and is far better at it than he is. She reads him perfectly, and every attempt he makes to catch her out backfires and leaves him blushing. He swears that one day he will be the one to embarrass her. The episodes are made of short, low-key scenes from school life, walks home and summer breaks, with little more at stake than who wins each round. Shin-Ei Animation adapted Soichiro Yamamoto's manga into 12 episodes, aired from January to March 2018, and later seasons followed. It is a gentle romantic comedy.

fuufu-ijou-koibito-miman.summary: Jiro Yakuin's high school runs a marriage practical, a programme that pairs third-year boys and girls to live together as couples, scoring them on how well they get along. Jiro hopes to be matched with Shiori Sakurazaka, his childhood friend and crush. Instead he gets Akari Watanabe, a flashy, outgoing girl who is just as disappointed because she likes Minami Tenjin, the popular boy who has been paired with Shiori. Pairs that score well enough can ask to switch partners, so Jiro and Akari agree to work together. studio MOTHER adapted Yuki Kanamaru's manga into 12 episodes in late 2022. It is a romantic comedy with some fan service.

takt-op.summary: In 2047, monsters called D2s have appeared after a black meteorite fell to Earth, and because music draws them in, playing it has been banned across the United States. The only ones able to fight them are Musicarts, girls who embody famous pieces of classical music, paired with human Conductors who guide them. Takt Asahina is a young pianist who cares about nothing but music. After an attack, he becomes the Conductor of a strange, gluttonous Musicart named Destiny, and the two set out on a road trip across the country with Anna Schneider. Madhouse and MAPPA produced this 12-episode series in late 2021 as part of a mixed-media project. Contains violence.

tomodachi-game.summary: Yuichi Katagiri believes money matters less than friendship, and he treasures his four close friends, Yutori, Shiho, Makoto and Tenji. Then the class trip money they collected is stolen, and soon after, all five are knocked out and wake up in a white room. A costumed figure called Manabu-kun explains that one of them has signed the group up to clear a debt of 20 million yen, and that they must pay it off by playing games designed to set friends against each other. Each round tests how much they really trust one another. Okuruto Noboru adapted the manga by Mikoto Yamaguchi and Yuki Sato into 12 episodes in spring 2022. It is a psychological thriller.

a-place-further-than-the-universe.summary: Mari Tamaki is a second-year high school student who keeps vowing to do something memorable with her youth, but she always loses her nerve. Then she meets Shirase Kobuchizawa, a classmate everyone laughs at because she has spent years saving money to go to Antarctica, where her mother went missing on an expedition. Inspired, Mari decides to go along, and the two are joined by Hinata, a cheerful convenience store worker, and Yuzuki, a teenage celebrity. Together they try to get a place on a civilian expedition. Madhouse produced this 13-episode original series in early 2018, directed by Atsuko Ishizuka and written by Jukki Hanada. It is a coming-of-age adventure.

little-witch-academia-tv.summary: As a little girl, Atsuko Kagari, known as Akko, was dazzled by a magic show by the witch Shiny Chariot and decided to become a witch herself. Even though she comes from an ordinary family with no magic at all, she enrolls at Luna Nova Magical Academy, a traditional school for witches. Akko is clumsy at spells and fails often, but she is cheerful and stubborn. She befriends quiet Lotte and the mischievous potion lover Sucy, clashes with the gifted Diana, and stumbles on the Shiny Rod, a wand that once belonged to Chariot. Trigger produced this 25-episode series in 2017, created and directed by Yoh Yoshinari, after two earlier short films.

yuusha-kei-ni-shosu-choubatsu-yuusha-900.summary: In this world, being made a Hero is not an honour but a criminal sentence. Convicts branded as Heroes are sent to fight the Demon Lords' endless armies, and if they die, they are revived and sent back to the front. Xylo Forbartz, formerly a decorated Holy Knights officer, now leads Penal Hero Unit 9004, a squad of thieves, frauds and misfits that the kingdom treats as disposable. On one mission he comes across Teoritta, a Goddess, one of the living weapons the war depends on, and she insists on standing with him. Studio KAI adapted Rocket Shokai's light novels into 12 episodes, aired from January to March 2026. Contains graphic violence.

boku-wa-tomodachi-ga-sukunai.summary: Kodaka Hasegawa transfers to a new high school hoping to make friends, but his blond hair and fierce-looking face get him labelled a delinquent, and a month later he is still alone. Then he catches classmate Yozora Mikazuki chatting happily with an imaginary friend in an empty room. Bonding over their loneliness, the two start the Neighbors Club, a club meant to help people with no friends learn how to make some. Its other members soon include Sena Kashiwazaki, a rich, beautiful girl who has no friends either and clashes with Yozora constantly. AIC Build adapted Yomi Hirasaka's light novels into 12 episodes in late 2011; a second season followed. Contains fan service.

yuru-camp.summary: Rin Shima prefers to camp alone, especially in winter, when the campsites around Mount Fuji are quiet. On one trip to a lakeside site, she meets Nadeshiko Kagamihara, a bubbly girl who has just moved to Yamanashi, set off to see Mount Fuji, fell asleep on the way and got stranded after dark. Rin shares her fire and a bowl of noodles with her, and the next day Nadeshiko is hooked on camping. She joins her school's small outdoor activities club and keeps crossing paths with Rin. The series follows their trips, gear and campfire cooking. C-Station adapted Afro's manga into 12 episodes in early 2018, directed by Yoshiaki Kyogoku.

amagi-brilliant-park.summary: Seiya Kanie is a clever, extremely vain high school student who thinks the mysterious Isuzu Sento is taking him on a date. Instead she brings him to Amagi Brilliant Park, a shabby amusement park where Princess Latifa Fleuranza asks him to become its acting manager. The park must reach 500,000 visitors within three months, or its land will be sold off for redevelopment. Its staff turn out to be magical beings from another world who depend on the joy of human guests, though most of them are also lazy or eccentric. Seiya reluctantly takes charge. Kyoto Animation adapted Shoji Gatoh's light novels into 13 episodes in late 2014, directed by Yasuhiro Takemoto.

akudama-drive.summary: In a future Kansai full of neon, holograms and surveillance, the most dangerous criminals are called Akudama. One day an ordinary young woman gets swept into a crime scene and, to avoid being killed, pretends to be a Swindler. She is pulled into a job alongside real Akudama, including a Courier, a Brawler, a Hacker and a Doctor, all hired by a mysterious talking black cat to free the killer Cutthroat before his public execution. The police's merciless Executioners are close behind. Pierrot and Too Kyo Games made this 12-episode original series in late 2020, conceived by Kazutaka Kodaka. Contains graphic violence.

btooom.summary: Ryota Sakamoto is unemployed, lives with his mother and one of the best players of an online combat game called Btooom! One day he wakes up on a tropical island with a green crystal set into his hand and a bag of bombs, and no idea how he got there. He realises the game has been recreated in real life: each player must kill seven others and collect their crystals to leave the island. Ryota does not want to kill anyone, but many of the people around him are not so restrained. He soon meets Himiko, a wary young woman. Madhouse adapted Junya Inoue's manga into 12 episodes in late 2012. Contains graphic violence, fan service and sexual assault themes.

boku-no-kokoro-no-yabai-yatsu.summary: Kyotaro Ichikawa is a gloomy middle school boy who spends class quietly imagining violent ends for his classmates, especially Anna Yamada, a tall, popular girl who works as a model. Then he starts running into her alone in the school library, where she snacks constantly, talks to herself and turns out to be far goofier than her image. Getting to know her slowly changes how Kyotaro sees her, and himself. The tone is mostly awkward, sweet and comic, despite the dark opening premise. Shin-Ei Animation adapted Norio Sakurai's web manga into 12 episodes, aired from April to June 2023, directed by Hiroaki Akagi, and a second season followed.

fugou-keiji-balance-unlimited.summary: Haru Kato is a hot-headed police detective who values justice and doing things by the book. After an incident, he is moved into a small new unit, the Modern Crime Prevention Headquarters, and partnered with Daisuke Kambe, an heir to an enormous fortune who has joined the police. Kambe solves problems by spending vast sums of money, backed by an AI assistant that can access almost anything, and his attitude infuriates Haru. As they work cases together, the two keep clashing over how far money should go in policing. CloverWorks produced this 11-episode series in 2020, directed by Tomohiko Ito and inspired by Yasutaka Tsutsui's novel The Millionaire Detective.

mieruko-chan.summary: Miko Yotsuya is an ordinary high school girl until, one day, she suddenly starts seeing ghosts, and they are horrifying, twisted creatures that cling to people and leer into her face. She suspects that if she reacts, things will get worse, so she decides to ignore them completely and act as if she sees nothing, no matter how close they get. That is easier said than done, especially around her cheerful best friend Hana Yurikawa, who seems to attract them. The series mixes horror imagery with comedy built on Miko's frozen poker face. Passione adapted Tomoki Izumi's manga into 12 episodes in late 2021. Contains grotesque imagery and fan service.

shinmai-maou-no-testament.summary: High schooler Basara Tojo's father comes home one day and announces that two girls are moving in as Basara's new stepsisters: Mio Naruse and her younger sister Maria. Soon after, his father leaves for work abroad, and the girls reveal they are demons. Mio is the daughter of the late Demon Lord and is hunted for the power she inherited, while Maria is a succubus. Basara, however, has his own secret: he comes from a village of Heroes who fight demons. He chooses to protect Mio, and an accidental magical master-servant contract binds them. Production IMS adapted Tetsuto Uesu's light novels into 12 episodes in early 2015. Contains heavy sexual content and nudity.

kyokou-suiri.summary: Kotoko Iwanaga is a small, sharp-tongued young woman who uses a cane and has an artificial eye. As a child she was chosen by the yokai, the spirits and monsters hidden around Japan, to be their goddess of wisdom, and she now settles their problems and keeps them from troubling humans. She has her eye on Kuro Sakuragawa, a quiet university student whom yokai are strangely afraid of. Their main case concerns Steel Lady Nanase, a faceless ghost said to haunt a city after an idol's death, which Kotoko tries to solve through clever, invented explanations. Brain's Base adapted the manga by Chasiba Katase, based on Kyo Shirodaira's novel, into 12 episodes in early 2020.

houseki-no-kuni-tv.summary: Far in the future, on a lone island, live the Lustrous, twenty-eight immortal beings made of gemstone. They cannot die, but they can be shattered, and they defend themselves against the Lunarians, who descend from the moon to take them away as ornaments. Phosphophyllite, called Phos, is the youngest and one of the most brittle, too fragile to fight and clumsy at everything else. Their teacher, Kongo, assigns Phos to write an encyclopedia, a task that leads them to Cinnabar, a lonely gem who patrols at night because their body leaks poison. Orange adapted Haruko Ichikawa's manga into 12 episodes in late 2017, directed by Takahiko Kyogoku. Contains action violence.

gokushufudou.summary: Tatsu was once a legendary yakuza enforcer known as the Immortal Dragon, feared by rival gangs across the city. He has walked away from crime and now works as a full-time househusband for his wife Miku, a busy career woman. He brings the same deadly seriousness to cooking, cleaning and chasing supermarket bargains that he once brought to gang wars, and his scowl and scarred face keep scaring neighbours, police officers and former associates who misread what he is doing. Each episode is a set of short comic scenes. J.C.Staff adapted Kousuke Oono's manga into five episodes in April 2021, with a second part following later. It is a gentle comedy.

yu-yu-hakusho.summary: Yusuke Urameshi is a 14-year-old delinquent who skips class, fights and is expected to amount to nothing. Then he dies pushing a small child out of the way of a car, a good deed so unexpected that the afterlife has no place prepared for him. Koenma, the son of the ruler of the Spirit World, offers him a way back, and once revived Yusuke is put to work as a Spirit Detective, investigating demons and supernatural crimes in the human world with the help of the cheerful ferry girl Botan. His loud rival Kuwabara soon joins in. Studio Pierrot adapted Yoshihiro Togashi's manga into 112 episodes from 1992 to 1995. Contains martial arts violence.

tsuki-ga-kirei.summary: As their last year of middle school begins, Kotaro Azumi and Akane Mizuno are placed in one class together. Kotaro is a quiet boy who dreams of becoming a novelist; Akane is a shy runner on the track team who gets nervous before every race. They barely know each other, but a few chance meetings start something, and they begin talking through clumsy text messages. The series follows a first romance closely and quietly, with exams, friends, rivals and family pressure all getting in the way. feel. produced this 12-episode original series, aired from April to June 2017. It is a slow, realistic love story.

ergo-proxy.summary: Long after an environmental disaster made the planet almost uninhabitable, people live inside sealed domed cities like Romdo, where life is tightly controlled and androids called AutoReivs serve every household. Now some AutoReivs are catching the Cogito virus, which makes them self-aware, and a string of strange killings follows. Re-l Mayer, a cold, capable inspector and granddaughter of the city's ruler, investigates with her AutoReiv partner Iggy. Meanwhile Vincent Law, a timid immigrant working to hunt down infected AutoReivs, seems tied to the mystery in ways he does not understand. Manglobe produced this 23-episode original series in 2006, directed by Shuko Murase and written by Dai Sato. Contains violence.

yuukoku-no-moriarty.summary: In late 19th-century Britain, the empire is rich and powerful, but a rigid class system lets aristocrats treat everyone else as worthless. William James Moriarty, adopted into a noble family, lives as a polished young gentleman with his brothers Albert and Louis. In private, he quietly helps ordinary people who have been wronged by the upper class, and he plans to tear the whole system down, by crime if necessary. Eventually his schemes will bring him face to face with the detective Sherlock Holmes. Production I.G adapted the manga by Ryosuke Takeuchi and Hikaru Miyoshi, a reimagining of Arthur Conan Doyle's villain, into 11 episodes in late 2020; a second part followed. Contains violence.

isekai-wa-smartphone-to-tomo-ni.summary: Touya Mochizuki dies when God, by mistake, strikes him with lightning. Apologising, God lets him start a new life in a fantasy world and grants a single request, and Touya asks to keep his smartphone, which God adjusts so it still works in the new world. He also turns out to have a talent for every kind of magic. Touya wanders the new world calmly and kindly, taking jobs, making friends and gathering a growing circle of girls who all fall for him, including the twin sisters Elze and Linze. Production Reed adapted Patora Fuyuhara's light novels into 12 episodes in summer 2017; a second season followed.

ore-monogatari.summary: Takeo Goda is a first-year high schooler built like a wrestler, with a huge frame and a face that scares girls away. He is also extremely kind and brave, and the boys at school admire him. The girls he likes, however, always fall for his handsome, quiet best friend Makoto Sunakawa. Then Takeo rescues a sweet, small girl named Rinko Yamato from a groper on a train. He is smitten, but assumes she must be interested in Sunakawa, as always. The series is an upbeat romantic comedy about kindness and honesty. Madhouse adapted Kazune Kawahara and Aruko's manga into 24 episodes in 2015, directed by Morio Asaka.

paprika.summary: At a psychiatric research institute, scientists have built the DC Mini, a device that lets a therapist enter a patient's dreams. Dr. Atsuko Chiba, a reserved researcher, secretly uses it to treat patients in their dreams as Paprika, a playful, bold alter ego. When several prototypes are stolen, someone starts using them to invade people's minds, and dreams begin spilling into the waking world, with the institute's staff among the first victims. Atsuko, the brilliant inventor Kosaku Tokita and a police detective try to find the thief. Satoshi Kon directed this Madhouse film, released in 2006 and based on Yasutaka Tsutsui's 1993 novel. Contains surreal, disturbing imagery and some violence.

gakusen-toshi-asterisk.summary: In the last century, a disaster called the Invertia changed the world and gave rise to the Genestella, people born with superhuman abilities. The best of them attend six academies in Asterisk, a city floating on a lake, where students fight in televised tournaments called the Festas. Ayato Amagiri arrives as a transfer student at Seidoukan Academy, a school that has been losing ground. On his first day, while returning a lost handkerchief, he sees Julis-Alexia von Riessfeld, a princess known for her fire powers, changing clothes, and she challenges him to a duel. A-1 Pictures adapted Yu Miyazaki's light novels into 12 episodes in late 2015; a second season followed. Contains fan service.

zero-no-tsukaima.summary: Louise Francoise Le Blanc de La Valliere is a noble student at the Tristain Academy of Magic, but nearly every spell she tries blows up, which has earned her the mocking nickname Louise the Zero. When the students must each summon a familiar, a magical servant, Louise's attempt brings forth Saito Hiraga, an ordinary teenage boy from Japan. Stuck in another world with no way home, Saito is treated like a pet by the proud, short-tempered Louise, until mysterious runes on his hand hint that he may be more than he seems. J.C.Staff adapted Noboru Yamaguchi's light novels into 13 episodes in summer 2006; three more seasons followed. Contains fan service and slapstick violence.

ao-no-hako.summary: Taiki Inomata is a first-year at a sports-focused high school who plays badminton. Every morning he trains early in the gym, partly because Chinatsu Kano, a second-year star of the girls' basketball team, is always there practising too. She seems out of reach. Then, when her parents move abroad for work, Chinatsu stays in Japan to keep playing, and because their mothers are old friends, she moves into Taiki's house. Neither is allowed to let anyone at school find out. Both push hard toward national tournaments while their feelings grow. Telecom Animation Film adapted Kouji Miura's manga into 25 episodes that ran through the 2024-25 season, and a second season followed. It is a sports romance.

blue-period.summary: Yatora Yaguchi is a popular second-year high schooler who gets good grades, goes out drinking with his friends and is good at reading what people want, yet he feels empty. One morning, after a night out, he finds himself struck by the blue tones of dawn over Shibuya and tries to paint what he saw. When someone is moved by the picture, he feels truly understood for the first time. He decides to aim for Tokyo University of the Arts, even though it is notoriously hard to get into, and has to learn art almost from scratch. Seven Arcs adapted Tsubasa Yamaguchi's manga into 12 episodes in late 2021. It is a coming-of-age drama.

kumo-desu-ga-nani-ka.summary: A mysterious explosion strikes a Japanese high school classroom, and the students and their teacher are reborn in a fantasy world that runs on game-like stats and skills. Many come back as nobles or royalty, but one quiet, unremarkable girl wakes up as a newly hatched spider, one of the weakest monsters, in a vast dungeon full of creatures that want to eat her. Talking to herself constantly, she sets out to survive, level up and evolve. A second storyline follows Shun, another classmate, who has been reborn as a prince. Millepensee adapted Okina Baba's light novels into 24 episodes in the first half of 2021. Contains violence.

sukitte-ii-na-yo.summary: Ever since classmates falsely blamed her for something when she was a child, Mei Tachibana has decided that friends only betray you, and she has gone through school without any. In her second year of high school, she kicks Yamato Kurosawa, the most popular boy in school, in a misunderstanding. Instead of being angry, Yamato is intrigued and keeps trying to get to know her, even giving her his phone number. When a stalker frightens her, he kisses her to drive the man away, and Mei begins, slowly and warily, to let people in. Zexcs adapted Kanae Hazuki's shojo manga into 13 episodes in late 2012. It is a romantic drama.

watashi-ga-motenai-no-wa-dou-kangaetemo-.summary: Tomoko Kuroki has played dozens of dating sims and believes she is ready to become popular when she starts high school. Weeks into the school year, she realises she has barely spoken to anyone. Extremely shy and socially awkward, she cannot hold a conversation without freezing up, yet inside her head she is boastful, bitter and full of schemes to make herself liked, nearly all of which go wrong. Her younger brother Tomoki puts up with her, and her middle school friend Yu, now at another school, is her only real friend. SILVER LINK. adapted Nico Tanigawa's web manga into 12 episodes in summer 2013. It is cringe comedy with crude and sexual humour.

zombieland-saga.summary: Sakura Minamoto is a high school girl who dreams of becoming an idol, until the morning she is hit by a truck. She wakes up years later in a mansion in Saga Prefecture, surrounded by other zombie girls, remembering nothing of her former life. A loud, sunglasses-wearing producer named Kotaro Tatsumi tells her he has brought them back to life for one purpose: to form an idol group and revive Saga, a prefecture many Japanese people forget about. Each of the girls comes from a different era. The series mixes slapstick horror, idol performances and some heartfelt drama. MAPPA produced this 12-episode original series in late 2018, with Avex Pictures and Cygames. Contains comic gore.

majo-no-tabitabi.summary: As a little girl, Elaina loves a book about the adventures of a travelling witch, and she dreams of exploring the world the same way. She becomes the youngest girl ever to pass the witch exam, then trains under Fran, a witch who seems carefree, before finally setting out alone on her broom with the title of the Ashen Witch. Each episode follows her to a new country or town, where she meets its people, hears their stories and usually moves on without getting too involved. Some stops are charming; others are disturbing. C2C adapted Jougi Shiraishi's light novels into 12 episodes in late 2020. Some episodes contain violence and dark themes.

isekai-de-cheat-skill-wo-te-ni-shita-ore.summary: Yuya Tenjo has been bullied all his life and treated with contempt even by his own parents, and the only person who loved him, his grandfather, has died. Living alone in his grandfather's old house, he discovers a door that opens onto another world full of monsters. Defeating them gives him game-style levels and stats, and he finds the house there once belonged to a great sage. As he grows stronger, he changes in the real world too, becoming tall, handsome and athletic, and he transfers to a new school where people suddenly notice him. Millepensee adapted Miku's light novels into 13 episodes in spring 2023. Contains fan service.
